comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: If I understand the Viking event guidelines right, collecting and handing over 9 Viking armors with names (like this one, and Helgi the Lean's Armour which are found with Search) to the Lady Buccaneer in London nets you the Craftsman Rigged Sail. You can sometimes get the viking armors from rare chest drops from plunder fleets as well (plunder rare Rogue's Treasure Chest, then hope it drops a rare Viking armor chest). There's still a bit of time left to do this event and get the rewards, so cheers.
